correctness.rationale: All star factors p>=2 have unique center. Intrinsic geodesic root-neighbor blocks classify automorphisms. The exact matrix exponential has factors cosh(sqrt(p) z) or sinh(sqrt(p) z)/sqrt(p). Nonzero coefficients a_j of log(tanh(sqrt(u))/sqrt(u) yield the first s power sums of active leaf counts from walk terms through order 3s<=3k. Newton identities reconstruct the full orbit profile. Root walks of lengths <=t are determined by t rounds of rooted colour refinement; the unique maximum-degree root is identified by one unmarked round. Exact finite checks cover 75 configurations and 344 independently verified walk-series vertices; finite checks are not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Identifies the exact coarsest equitable partition as automorphism orbits on all products of arbitrarily heterogeneous nonregular stars, an infinite family of unbounded order and degree. Provides a uniform dimension-only round bound, exact class counts and sizes, and a nontrivial walk-moment reconstruction beyond degree and rooted distance (collision at sizes 2,3,4,5). No downstream general theorem is claimed.
